text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. Later, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a film. I always go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel calm and full of energy.
